findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bridge_promotion_verdict · Private data: bridge_account_status, bridge_scoreboard, bridge_promotion_verdict · Public sink: bridge_promotion_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bridge_promotion_verdict · Private data: bridge_account_status, bridge_scoreboard, bridge_promotion_verdict · Public sink: bridge_promotion_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
